meta.judged_on: 2026 only (owner order 2026-10-18): parameters picked on Jan 2 - Jun 30 2026, checked on Jul 1 - Oct 16 2026; 2021-25 is a reference line, never a gate

data.source: TradingView CME NQ1! continuous futures, 5-minute bars (data/NQ_5m.csv); 1-minute bars for 2026 (data/NQ_1m.csv) for the entry and trade management; VIX daily (data/VIX_1d.csv)

sizing.rule: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop; MNQ $2/pt; max 40 micros; no trade under 1 micro (engine/lit.py qty_for). Weekly stop: after 2 STOP exits in the calendar week, half size for the rest of it (one rounding, floor 1 micro). No cold-streak filter, no late-entry rule. Switch lit_sizing.mode (normal / eval / fast_eval / safe_eval / two_week); live: two_week (one winner passes, 60% of the eval room, $1,000 soft daily loss cap, 40 micros, min 1). Scale-in (built and safety-reviewed 2026-10-20, OFF: "scale_in": null until the owner's Sim101 roundtrip, python -m engine.ninjatrader --sim-roundtrip-add, passes): one add after breakeven, sized by engine/sizing.scale_in_qty (its open risk never above the first entry's).

eval_safe_option.what: half size when the sweep extreme is outside Tue 03:00 - Wed 11:30 ET; 2026 +$27.8k (PF 3.17) instead of +$38.9k, max DD -$2.3k instead of -$3.1k, no eval failed within 2 weeks, pass rate 86% instead of 80%

modes.normal: the LIT rule: $800 up to a 20-pt stop, then 800x20/stop, max 40 micros (then the weekly stop)
modes.fast_eval: eval speed: $800 up to a 40-pt stop, then 800x40/stop (run lit_x_fast_eval: 2-week passes H1 52% / H2 47%, but 21-27% of evals fail in 2 weeks)
modes.safe_eval: never risk more than 60% of the room between the eval balance and the trailing max-loss floor: micros capped at 0.6 x room / (stop x $2), min 1 (run lit_x_room_cap60: 1-month fails H1 25.8% -> 10.2%)
modes.eval: eval (on since 2026-10-18): $800 up to a 25-pt stop, then 800x25/stop, then never more than 60% of the room to the trailing max-loss floor (run lit_tight_eval_800_25_room60: 2-week passes H1 37.5% / H2 29.5% vs 28.9 / 23.1, fails 3.1 / 0.0 unchanged)
modes.two_week: two-week eval (on since 2026-10-18, owner order: pass within 10 sessions): one winner passes - micros so the trade's target covers what is still needed to +$3,000, capped at 60% of the room to the trailing max-loss floor (room_f 0.6), a full stop-out inside the $1,000 soft daily loss, 40 micros, min 1; no weekly stop; no new trade once the day reached the target; sessions counted from eval_start; no reset (owner 2026-10-18): after session 10 the eval keeps going in safe_eval (two_week_until 10, after_mode safe_eval; tools/lit_eventual.py: eventual pass ~80/77% H1/H2, median 7/5 sessions) (run lit_2wk_rec = config C: 2-week pass H1 52.9% / H2 50.7%, fail 8.4% / 2.9%, $174 / $181 per 2-week pass at $91.80; max risk ~$990 a trade, worst day ~-$1,008). Missing target / eval state: the eval mode
modes.funded: funded (after the pass; NOT on yet: needs funded_state wiring in live.py / cloud_monitor): risk 40% of the room to the floor, at most $800 (800x20/stop beyond 20 pts), target pays at most $1,500 (50% best-day payout rule), weekly stop, skip when 1 micro could reach the floor (run lit_funded_rec: lost in 6 months ~1%, ~$740-770/mo paid)

lit_sizing.note: two_week mode ON (2026-10-18, owner order: an eval must pass within 2 weeks); eval / normal / fast_eval / safe_eval stay available; applied by the cloud monitor ledger and the PC bot (engine/sizing.py lit_qty), eval_start = the first session of the current eval (set it on every new purchase; the PC start cfg "eval_start" overrides it)
lit_sizing.eval_mode_note: mode eval ($800 up to a 25-pt stop + 60% room cap) stays available: set mode back to "eval"
lit_sizing.eval_prior_note: owner 2026-10-18: the Builder 50K eval was at -$100 (balance $49,900) when the bot went live; counted as one day before eval_start (needs $3,100, room $1,900)

loss_rules.text: Monday rule: once Monday took Friday's high only shorts, once it took Friday's low only longs; weekly stop: after 2 stop-outs in a calendar week, half size for the rest of it

management.text: since 2026-10-20 (1m bars only for the first two): 15-minute check (cut a trade that never reached +0.5R and closes over 0.3R under water 15 min after the fill); scale-in after breakeven (one add on the first 0.25R pullback + 1m CISD, its risk never above the first entry's; trades carry 'adds', qty = the first entry, pnl = all of it); breakeven stop at entry + 1.25 pts (the costs)

meta.method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, every value known at the close of its bar). The live loop runs the same code on the recent bars (engine/lit_live.py): tests/test_lit_live.py replays every 2026 session and gets the same trades. 2026 days with full 1m bars enter and are managed on 1m bars; 2021-25 (no 1m data) on 5m bars, so 2021-25 is a reference line, not a check of the 1m entry. Evals use the MFFU Builder 50K rules ($3k target, $2k end-of-day trailing max loss locking at $50,100).

summary.how_it_learns: Each factor's average R is compared with the overall average separately in 2021-25 and in 2026. LIT is judged on 2026 (owner order 2026-10-18); 2021-25 has no 1m bars, so there it enters on 5m bars and is a reference only. A rule is adopted only after it is picked on Jan-Jun 2026 and holds on Jul-Oct 2026.
